# The Fashion Law

> > The Fashion Law covers the intersection of fashion, business, and legal issues, from intellectual property disputes and trademark infringement to sustainability, celebrity cases, and luxury brand litigation.

The Fashion Law is a leading publication analyzing legal developments in the fashion industry, covering major brands like Louis Vuitton, Burberry, and Supreme Court cases, as well as emerging issues around social media rights, environmental impact, and diversity in fashion.

## Key Topics

- Copyright infringement
- Trademark infringement
- Intellectual property
- Luxury fashion brands
- Instagram and social media rights
- Paparazzi and photographer rights
- Brand protection
- Celebrity legal cases
- Sustainability and fast fashion
- Fashion industry regulation
- Louis Vuitton
- Burberry
- Supreme Court decisions
- California federal court
- Fashion designer rights

## Intellectual Property and Trademark Disputes

- [Louis Vuitton Wins the Last Round in Fight Over "My Other Bag"](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/louis-vuitton-wins-the-last-round-in-fight-over-my-other-bag): Louis Vuitton wins $1M legal fees victory over My Other Bag parody case
- [Adidas Prevails in Japanese Trademark Fight Over "adidog"](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/adidas-prevails-in-trademark-fight-of-adidog-pet-clothing): Adidas wins Japan Patent Office fight over 'adidog' pet clothing trademark
- [Super-Influencer Chiara Ferragni Lands Win in "Chiara" Trademark Case](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/super-influencer-chiara-ferragni-lands-win-in-chiara-trademark-case): Chiara Ferragni wins EUIPO trademark dispute over her first name
- [Urban Outfitters Slapped With Lawsuit Over Gender-Free Fragrance](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/urban-outfitters-slapped-with-lawsuit-over-gender-free-fragrance): Eris accuses Urban Outfitters of copying trademark and marketing text
- [Nike is Pushing for Legislation to Help Fight Against the Import of Patent-Infringing Goods](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/nike-is-pushing-for-legislation-to-help-fight-against-the-import-of-infringing-goods): Nike seeks customs legislation to block patent-infringing imports at border
- [Enough is Enough, Says Richard Louderback in New Lawsuit Over FUCT's Alleged Infringement of Jaws Motif](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/fuct-and-richardson-are-at-the-center-of-new-copyright-infringement-lawsuit-over-jaws-inspired-collab): Artist sues FUCT and Richardson over unauthorized Jaws-inspired artwork use

## Social Media and Paparazzi Photo Rights

- [Another Day, Another Paparazzi Photo Case: Christian Siriano is Being Sued Over Lady Gaga Post](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/another-day-another-paparazzi-photo-case-christian-siriano-is-being-sued-over-lady-gaga-post): Christian Siriano sued over unauthorized Instagram post of Lady Gaga photo
- ["Every One of Minaj's Instagram Posts is Fundamentally Promotional," Splash News Claims in New Suit](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/every-one-of-minajs-instagram-posts-is-fundamentally-promotional-splash-news-claims-in-new-suit): Splash News sues Nicki Minaj over unauthorized Instagram paparazzi photos
- [California Court Shoots Down Part of Brooke Shields' Case Over Charlotte Tilbury Eyebrow Pencil](https://www.thefashionlaw.com/california-court-shoots-down-part-of-brooke-shields-case-over-charlotte-tilbury-eyebrow-pencil): Court partially dismisses Brooke Shields' case over 'Brooke S.' eyebrow pencil
